integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action Chinese family drama, a medium-wide shot preserves the modest apartment dining room, warm overhead lighting, wooden table, homework books, ceramic bowls, and the exact identities, clothing, positions, and spatial relationships of the father, mother, and young boy established in <Picture 1>. The tired father at the doorway takes two restrained steps toward the table and slowly raises the lit phone to chest height, keeping its screen unreadable. The mother pauses over the homework, turns her head and upper body toward him, and her expression tightens as she notices the phone. The boy stops writing, lowers his pencil, and looks cautiously from his mother to his father. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed while all motion remains natural and subdued. No one speaks and no hard cut occurs.

overall_soundscape: Quiet nighttime apartment room tone continues underneath soft footsteps, a faint jacket rustle, the pencil touching the tabletop, and distant muffled city traffic outside. No intelligible speech and no crying.
